name: Add Intent Leads to PlusVibe
description: Daily 11:00 PlusVibe enroller. Loops Clients with Intent Tables; pulls done+NEW rows whose Target Campaign is a PV campaign id (not a URL) and adds each lead by Final Email via PV lead/add. ROUTED/FAILED/NO EMAIL stamped; one log row per client.

parameters.filterByFormula: =AND({Status}='done', {Email Campaign}!='', {Email Routed At}='', OR({Intent Status}='NEW', {Intent Status}='ROUTED', AND({Intent Status}='FAILED', FIND("spacing", {Enroll Error}))))
